name: RetreatUI 1.1.5
body: RetreatUI 1.1.5 moves the Guardian Formation state tracker, including Assault Formation, 10 pixels upward so it clears the primary resource bar. The offset is Guardian-specific and does not change the shared placement used by other class stance, form, oath, aspect or presence trackers.

name: RetreatUI 1.1.4
body: RetreatUI 1.1.4 adds a distinct tank no-aggro warning for caster and mana-user TurboPlates, removes duplicate HUD spells such as Unleash Pestilence, moves the Guardian stance tracker clear of the resource bar, and prevents party-frame name and health text overlap.

name: RetreatUI 1.1.3
body: RetreatUI 1.1.3 reorganizes class HUDs so learned offensive and rotational abilities stay on Main, while defensive and utility abilities stay on Utility. Main now wraps after nine icons, including the custom Knight of Xoroth HUD. The release also includes the verified Eternal Bloodmage classifications, additional class cooldown coverage, and Ascension-focused stability improvements.

name: RetreatUI 1.1.3-beta.2
body: Safety follow-up to beta.1. Removes active inspect, talent and unsafe learned-state fallbacks; adds 9-plus-rest wrapping to the custom Knight of Xoroth HUD; keeps offensive abilities on Main and defensive/utility abilities on Utility; preserves the verified Eternal Bloodmage corrections; removes retired party tracker source files; fixes the Buff Manager texture path; and updates the in-game beta.2 changelog.
